papers.title: Discovery of (4-Pyrazolyl)-2-aminopyrimidines as Potent and Selective Inhibitors of Cyclin-Dependent Kinase 2
papers.one_line: A screening hit that was really a JAK2 inhibitor, turned into a CDK2 inhibitor selective over five other CDKs.

papers.title: Discovery of Potent and Selective Inhibitors of Wild-Type and Gatekeeper Mutant Fibroblast Growth Factor Receptor (FGFR) 2/3
papers.one_line: An inhibitor that still works on the gatekeeper mutants that defeat the approved pan-FGFR drugs, while sparing FGFR1.
